blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings including a Black Glass Tasting and Vineyard Tour & Tasting. The winery offers private and group experiences, a restaurant with seasonal menus, and hosts weddings and private events. Tours run spring through autumn as weather allows.
extraNote: Tasting fees are not refunded with purchase; Private, Library or Vineyard Tastings receive 20% off any purchase · Wine Club members receive 50% off Black Glass Tasting once per month and complimentary Wine Tasting Experience (4 guests max, one visit per month) · Full money back guarantee on all online purchases under certain conditions; 60 days to return or exchange unopened items with valid receipt · At the winery location, 3955 Cherry Ave., Vineland, ON · Tours run Spring – Autumn as weather allows
